<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Track the project's demands, stages and weighted tasks in anchors.progress.md.

```text
Keeps anchors.progress.md, the project's progress: its demands (a plan in development, or any
other piece of work), their optional stages, and their tasks, each with a weight — an estimate
of its effort in the unit anchors.yaml names (progress.unit, default points). Progress is the
done weight over the weight not cancelled.

  anchors progress add demand "Checkout" --plan plans/0012-checkout.md
  anchors progress add stage D01 "Payment"
  anchors progress add task D01.S1 "refund rules" --weight 5
  anchors progress start D01.T4         (held by you; --take to take another agent's)
  anchors progress done D01.T4
  anchors progress reopen D01.T4 | cancel D01.T4 --reason "…" | weigh D01.T4 8
  anchors progress rename D01.S2 "Payment"     a new title; the id and the history stay

Work the plan does not list, done for it, is recorded before it is done — where it arises,
marked so it is seen:
  anchors progress add task D01.S2 "fix the date parser" --weight 2 --unplanned
  anchors progress unplanned D01.T31 [--undo]   mark a task already added
  anchors progress move D01.T31 D01.S2         take a task to the stage it arose in
  anchors progress drop D01.S8                 remove a stage left with no task
  anchors progress summary              the demands and their stages, with their progress
  anchors progress show [D01] [--json]  every task

Only these commands write the file: it is never edited by hand, and a hand edit is refused.
Each change takes the file's lock, so agents working at once lose nothing.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors progress [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## Subcommands

### `anchors progress add`

Add a demand, a stage or a task.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress add [flags]
```

### `anchors progress cancel`

Take a task out of the count, with the reason.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress cancel <task> --reason <why> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--reason` |  | why the task leaves the count (required) |

### `anchors progress done`

Mark a task done.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress done <task> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--by` |  | who (default: this agent's identity) |

### `anchors progress drop`

Remove a stage left with no task.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress drop <stage> [flags]
```

### `anchors progress move`

Take a task to another stage of its demand; its id and history stay.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress move <task> <demand|stage> [flags]
```

### `anchors progress rename`

Give a demand, a stage or a task a new title; its id and history stay.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress rename <demand|stage|task> <title> [flags]
```

### `anchors progress reopen`

Put a task back to do.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress reopen <task> [flags]
```

### `anchors progress show`

Every task of the file, or of one demand.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress show [demand] [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | print JSON |

### `anchors progress start`

Mark a task in progress, held by you.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress start <task> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--by` |  | who (default: this agent's identity) |
| `--take` |  | take over a task another agent holds |

### `anchors progress summary`

What is in progress: each demand and its stages, with their progress — never the tasks.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress summary [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | print JSON |

### `anchors progress unplanned`

Mark a task as work the plan did not list (--undo takes the mark off).

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress unplanned <task> [--undo] [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--undo` |  | take the mark off |

### `anchors progress weigh`

Set a task's weight.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors progress weigh <task> <weight> [flags]
```

## The work queue — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors next`](/docs/cli/commands/next/) | Pull and claim the next item from the queue (the worker calls this) |
| [`anchors queue`](/docs/cli/commands/queue/) | List live tasks (the work the watcher queued) |
| [`anchors work`](/docs/cli/commands/work/) | Emit the work prompt of a stage (spec\|code\|feature\|test\|review) for a target |
| [`anchors done`](/docs/cli/commands/done/) | Close claimed task(s) (moves to the .anchors/done/ history) |
| [`anchors drop`](/docs/cli/commands/drop/) | Discard a task from the queue without completing it (removes; does not archive) |
| [`anchors reclaim`](/docs/cli/commands/reclaim/) | Return to the queue the tasks stuck in claimed (dead worker) |
| [`anchors deliver`](/docs/cli/commands/deliver/) | Record the delivery of a stage — the review trigger |
| [`anchors decided`](/docs/cli/commands/decided/) | Release the card `escalate --for-user` stopped, once the decision is made |
| [`anchors discard`](/docs/cli/commands/discard/) | Take off the board the card that no longer makes sense, without deleting it |
| [`anchors unblock`](/docs/cli/commands/unblock/) | Open the work card that unblocks a card stuck in `needs-user` |
| [`anchors escalate`](/docs/cli/commands/escalate/) | Open the issue for a change needed in the plan or the spec |
| [`anchors report-bug`](/docs/cli/commands/report-bug/) | Report a bug in Anchors itself at github.com/co2-lab/anchors |
| [`anchors synthesize`](/docs/cli/commands/synthesize/) | Two PRs conflicting in CONTENT become a synthesis card |
| [`anchors watch`](/docs/cli/commands/watch/) | The background watcher: sees changes and QUEUES work |
| [`anchors monitor`](/docs/cli/commands/monitor/) | Watch the project's long processes: one line when one starts, stalls, dies or ends |
| [`anchors flow`](/docs/cli/commands/flow/) | Operate the work flows (the puzzle of actions and results) |
| [`anchors board`](/docs/cli/commands/board/) | The project board — published by the pipeline, or served live |
| **`anchors progress`** | Track the project's demands, stages and weighted tasks in anchors.progress.md |

<!-- cli-reference:end -->
